causes.label: Fuse is blown, or the circuit breaker tripped
remedies: Replace fuse or reset circuit breaker.
Remove any other appliances from the circuit.
Try pressing the START/RESET pad (Electronic models) two times.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Fuse is blown, or the circuit breaker tripped"

causes.label: Power is turned off
remedies: In some installations, power to the dishwasher is provided through a wall switch, often located next to the disposer switch.
Make sure it is on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Power is turned off"

causes.label: Some of the sounds
remedies: Soft food disposal shredding action.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Some of the sounds"

symptoms.symptom: Water standing in the bottom of the tub

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: A small amount of clean water around the outlet on the tub bottom at the back of the tub keeps the water seal lubricated.

symptoms.symptom: Water won’t pump out of the tub

causes.label: Drain is clogged
remedies: If you have an air gap, clean it.
Check to see if your kitchen sink is draining well.
If not, you may need a plumber.
If the dishwasher drains into a disposer, run disposer clear.

causes.label: Wrong detergent was used
remedies: Use only automatic dishwasher detergents to avoid sudsing.
Cascade®, Cascade® Complete and Electrasol® Automatic Dishwashing Detergents have been approved for use in all GE dishwashers.
To remove suds from the tub, open the dishwasher and let suds dissipate.
Add 1 gallon of cold water to the tub.
On Models with a Dial: Close and latch the dishwasher.
Pump out water by slowly turning the Dial until a drain period is reached.
Repeat if necessary.
On Models with Electronic Control: Pump out water by pressing the START/RESET pad, then 10 seconds later, press START/RESET pad again.
Repeat if necessary.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Wrong detergent was used"

causes.label: Some tomato-based
remedies: Use of the RINSE ONLY cycle after adding the dish to the load

causes.label: Low inlet water temperature
remedies: Make sure inlet water temperature is at least 120°F.
Select HEATED DRY.
Use HOT START and ADDED HEAT options.
Select a higher cycle, such as POTS & PANS or HEAVY WASH.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Low inlet water temperature"

causes.label: Rinse agent dispenser is empty
remedies: Check the rinse agent dispenser and fill as required.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Rinse agent dispenser is empty"

symptoms.symptom: Spots and filming on glasses and flatware

causes.label: Overloading the dishwasher
remedies: 1 Remove all metal utensils from the dishwasher. 2 Do not add detergent.

causes.label: Improper loading
remedies: 3 Select the longest cycle.

causes.label: Old or damp powder detergent
remedies: 4 Start the dishwasher and allow to run for 18 to 22 minutes.
Dishwasher will now be in the main wash.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Old or damp powder detergent"

causes.label: Rinse agent dispenser empty
remedies: 5 Open the door and pour 2 cups (500 ml) of white vinegar into the bottom of the dishwasher.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Rinse agent dispenser empty"

causes.label: Too little detergent
remedies: 6 Close the door and allow to complete the cycle.
If vinegar rinse doesn’t work: Repeat as above, except use 1/4 cup (60 ml) of citric acid crystals instead of vinegar.

causes.label: Combination of soft water and too much detergent
remedies: This is called etching and is permanent.
To prevent this from happening, use less detergent if you have soft water.
Wash glassware in the shortest cycle that will get it clean.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Combination of soft water and too much detergent"

causes.label: Dial is not in the OFF position
remedies: Turn the Timer Dial to OFF.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Dial is not in the OFF position"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Steam comes through the vent by the door latch during drying and when water is being pumped out.

symptoms.symptom: Control panel responded to inputs but dishwasher never filled with water

causes.label: Door latch may not be properly seated
remedies: Call for service.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Door latch may not be properly seated"
